'''Vjeko Keskic''' (DeckTech handle '''mighty_maul''')<ref name="dt-26368">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/26368 My Keskic Is This Deal Legal aka The Croatian Deal v2 1], DeckTech (Vjeko "mighty_maul" Keskic, 24 November 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/26368/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/26368/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009014432/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/26368/ Wayback Machine].</ref> posted a [[Light]] [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This...]] list on DeckTech (''Rumble In The Bronx With Mains'')<ref name="dt-23859">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23859 Rumble In The Bronx With Mains], DeckTech (Vjeko "mighty_maul" Keskic, 10 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23859/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23859/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009110318/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23859/ Wayback Machine].</ref> and finished 3rd at [[2002 Ralltiir Regionals]] with a [[Dark]] [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Of The Vile Gangster]] list (''Court Likes Direct Damage aka Gailid Superstar'').<ref name="dt-23606">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23606 Court Likes Direct Damage aka Gailid Superstar], DeckTech (Vjeko "mighty_maul" Keskic, 27 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23606/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23606/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009130803/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23606/ Wayback Machine].</ref> He posted a [[Dark]] [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!]] list (''All Your Damage Belongs To Watto'').<ref name="dt-23561">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23561 All Your Damage Belongs To Watto], DeckTech (Vjeko "mighty_maul" Keskic, 25 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23561/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23561/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009143952/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23561/ Wayback Machine].</ref> He played the [[2019 European Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-european-championships/ 2019 European Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
